caption: The drawing depicts a man and a dog next to a wooden water well pump. The man is standing on a wooden platform, wearing a dark hat, brownish scarf, olive green long-sleeved shirt, dark pants, and brown shoes. He is operating a large, dark brown wooden lever attached to an upright wooden post, which is the main structure of the well pump. A chain is hanging from the pump down into a wooden trough located in the foreground. The trough is rectangular, made of brown wood, and contains water. There is a dog with a dark brown coat and a yellow collar drinking from the trough. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or scenery present in the composition.
title: Man Pumping Water
